answer: Mechanism: a linear admission bond. The contract prices each new identity at c*n (n = attested identities), locked 30 epochs before vesting. Enforcement is contractual: settlement excludes any identity lacking a locked bond, and the deposit binds to an attested hardware root plus an aged cipher key that cannot be parallel-reset, so re-minted keys recycle nothing. Cost: fakes are sparrows, cheap singly, ruinous as a flock - each puppet posts its own c*n deposit, timber priced log by log, so attack cost grows at least linearly in n; honest users pay once, collusion forfeits.
